cohort: 14 live-born offspring from 14 pregnancies (including one triplet pregnancy) of 6 PKU-affected females who remained on pegvaliase treatment throughout their pregnancy.
finding: Pegvaliase was effective at maintaining safe maternal blood phenylalanine levels during pregnancy without causing deleterious effects on the mother or child, though a higher rate of preterm birth (36%) was observed in the offspring.
birth_weight: All offspring had normal growth parameters.
gest_age: Four of eleven infants (36%) were delivered preterm.
